lenderSync.title: Defensive Lender Synchronization
lenderSync.problem: A lender integration could return partial XML. If the system simply applied the received data, previously populated fields could be lost.
lenderSync.solution: Implemented a defensive synchronization strategy where existing data is preserved when the external payload does not provide a new value.

mismoConversion.title: MISMO Conversion Layer
mismoConversion.problem: Need to convert data between external MISMO format and internal application domain model in both directions.
mismoConversion.solution: Bidirectional conversion layer with mapping, validation, compatibility and interoperability — enabling consistent import and export.

resilientIntegration.title: Resilient Third-Party Integration
resilientIntegration.problem: Third-party system integrations were subject to intermittent failures, timeouts and inconsistent responses.
resilientIntegration.solution: Implemented retries with exponential backoff, circuit breaker, structured logging and observability for defensive processing.

items.question: Does WSS IT build systems from scratch?
items.answer: Yes. We develop custom systems from a real business need or process. Each project starts by understanding the problem, then moves through planning, development and delivery.

items.question: Can you integrate systems that already exist?
items.answer: Yes. We connect internal systems, third-party APIs, legacy platforms and external services so data and processes flow automatically and reliably.

items.question: Do you work with third-party APIs?
items.answer: Yes. We have extensive experience with REST integrations, XML, Webhooks and third-party APIs — including financial, lender and enterprise platform APIs.

items.question: Can you automate processes with AI?
items.answer: Yes. We apply AI to automate real processes — document analysis, classification, data extraction, email workflows and report generation.

items.question: Can you take over existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. We provide troubleshooting, debugging, performance analysis, broken integration fixes and legacy system modernization.

items.question: Can I hire just a technical assessment?
items.answer: Yes. We offer consulting for architecture review, code review, technical planning and systems analysis — without the need to hire a full project.

items.question: Does WSS IT work with companies outside Brazil?
items.answer: Yes. We serve companies across different industries in Brazil and internationally, adapting technology to each business context and objective.

items.question: How does the quote process work?
items.answer: You describe the problem, idea or opportunity. We analyze the information, understand the context and return with a tailored technical and commercial proposal.
